README.md · Author-provided

Bytes

A utility library for working with bytes.

Crates.io Build Status

Documentation

Usage

To use bytes, first add this to your Cargo.toml:

[dependencies]
bytes = "1"

Next, add this to your crate:

use bytes::{Bytes, BytesMut, Buf, BufMut};

no_std support

To use bytes with no_std environment, disable the (enabled by default) std feature.

[dependencies]
bytes = { version = "1", default-features = false }

To use bytes with no_std environment without atomic CAS, such as thumbv6m, you also need to enable the extra-platforms feature. See the documentation for the portable-atomic crate for more information.

The MSRV when extra-platforms feature is enabled depends on the MSRV of portable-atomic.

Serde support

Serde support is optional and disabled by default. To enable use the feature serde.

[dependencies]
bytes = { version = "1", features = ["serde"] }

The MSRV when serde feature is enabled depends on the MSRV of serde.

Building documentation

When building the bytes documentation the docsrs option should be used, otherwise feature gates will not be shown. This requires a nightly toolchain:

RUSTDOCFLAGS="--cfg docsrs" cargo +nightly doc

API polish in preparation for a 1.0 release.

Changed

  • BufMut::bytes_vectored_mut() (#430).
  • new methods on combinator types (#434).

  • Relax synchronization when cloning in shared vtable of Bytes.
  • Move loom to dev-dependencies.

Added

Fix
  • Fix BufMut::advance_mut to panic if advanced passed the capacity (#354)..

Reporting & security

Abuse reporting and a confidential registry security contact are not configured in this playground. No report is sent here.

For a package vulnerability, follow its upstream repository’s security policy. You can find its source link in the package’s Metadata section.
